pack.source_title: IRAS: Tax Residency of a Company / Certificate of Residence

tests.label: At least 50% of strategic directors physically in Singapore or chair physically in Singapore for virtual meetings
tests.quote: At least 50% of the directors (with the authority to make strategic decisions) are physically in Singapore during the meetings

not_supported.requirement: location of board meetings where strategic decisions are made usually determines where control and management is exercised
not_supported.quote: Usually, the location of the company's Board of Directors meetings where strategic decisions are made determines where the control and management is exercised.

not_supported.requirement: holding board meetings in Singapore may not be sufficient in certain scenarios
not_supported.quote: holding Board of Directors meetings in Singapore may not be sufficient

not_supported.requirement: whether any board meetings are held in Singapore is a factor considered
not_supported.quote: Whether there is any board of directors' meetings held in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether strategic decisions are made at Singapore board meetings is a factor considered
not_supported.quote: Whether any strategic decisions are made at the board of directors' meetings held in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether directors are based in or outside Singapore is a factor considered
not_supported.quote: Whether the directors are based in or outside Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether strategic decisions are made by the local director in Singapore is a factor considered
not_supported.quote: Whether any strategic decisions are made by the local director in Singapore

not_supported.requirement: whether key employees are based in Singapore is a factor considered
not_supported.quote: Whether there are key employees based in Singapore
